alate: Head capsule dark brown, labrum brown, antennae brown with the articulations slightly paler, frontal gland aperture pale yellowish brown; pronotum dark brown, abdominal tergites and legs pale brown, head capsule and pronotum densely covered with short hairs. Head capsule oval, the frontal gland aperture narrow and small, elliptical. Compound eyes circular, protrusion about 16%; ocelli oval, the ocellus–compound eye distance slightly greater than the short diameter of the ocellus and smaller than its long diameter. Postclypeus slightly raised, the median suture distinct, less than half as long as wide. Antennae 13 segments, broken; the second to fourth subequal and all rather short, the segments from the fifth onwards progressively longer. Pronotum flat, the anterior margin slightly raised from a shallow arcuate depression, neither the anterior nor the posterior margin with a central incision. Tibial spur formula 2:2:2, tarsi 4-segmented.
